chunks: Nor given leave to make excuses.

key_terms.فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ: so they will excuse themselves/make excuses

ai.seo_question: What happens to disbelievers when they are denied entry to Paradise regarding their excuses?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine judgment, where the 'no permission' (la yu'adzan) signifies a complete closure of the door for self-justification, contrasting with the intercession granted to believers. It highlights that their excuses will be rejected not merely due to lack of opportunity, but because their deeds were fundamentally devoid of truth, rendering their words empty. This reflects the principle that on the Day of Resurrection, actions speak louder than rhetorical defenses.
